items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: She come down to Birdland, and her and Osie C. was great friends at the time.

ctx.x: Yeah, Paul Gonsalves. And she knew him and she come on the bus to talk to him. She was working up in Maine. She could sing too.
So then I didn't see her no more till New York. She come down to Birdland, and her and Osie C. was great friends at the time.
